name: Italy

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 58943464 inhabitants, recorded as 58.943 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-28, in Italian, in the transversal venues pass. Three units, three houses, against an opening estimate of 4. This is a floor and a low one, and the record is disputed on that rather than on any of the three. Italy is the country the known_bias of this indicator names first, and the pass confirms the mechanism exactly. Italian teatro di figura is organised in companies — compagnie and famiglie d'arte, several of them recognised by the Ministero della Cultura and by their regions — and the Ministry funds organisations rather than licensing halls, so no national list of puppetry venues exists to read. What had to be done instead was to take known figure-theatre organisations one at a time and ask which of them holds a hall. Most do not. The three that do. Teatro Mongiovino, via Giovanni Genocchi 15 in the Garbatella, has been the house of the Teatro delle Marionette degli Accettella since 1987, when the company bought and rebuilt it as its production seat; two hundred seats, a season of family performances and weekday matinées for schools, four hundred marionettes shown inside the hall itself, and the MiC and the Regione Lazio on its pages. Teatro Gioco Vita in Piacenza is recognised as a Centro di Produzione Teatrale by the Ministry and by the Emilia-Romagna region, has worked in shadow theatre since the late 1970s and holds the artistic and organisational direction of three halls in the city — the Teatro Municipale, the Teatro Filodrammatici and the Teatro Gioia. It is counted once: the indicator counts the permanent puppetry unit, not the buildings it runs. The Teatro Bruno Munari in via Giovanni Bovio 5 in Milan is two thousand square metres of hall, workshops and rehearsal rooms built by the Comune di Milano and run by the Teatro del Buratto, which won the city's public tender for its multi-year management in 2017 and has played actor theatre and figure theatre since 1975, carrying the black-theatre technique. Munari is the weakest of the three on vocation, because Buratto is a children's theatre company that does figure theatre rather than a puppetry company, and it sits close to the line Kolibri settled. One case shows why the count is low and it is the clearest refusal of the pass. The Teatro delle Briciole has held the Teatro al Parco in the Parco Ducale as its stable venue since 1987 by agreement with the Comune di Parma, is funded by the city, the Ministry and the region, and hosts the Festival Impertinente devoted to teatro di figura. It is not counted, and the ground has to be stated exactly, because the obvious one is wrong. The denominator does not exclude a puppetry strand as such: it excludes programming strands that maintain no permanent ensemble, and the qualifier binds. What excludes the Briciole is two other things. The Festival Impertinente is a festival, and festivals are excluded by name. And the Briciole itself is a children's theatre with no puppetry unit named anywhere in it and no permanent puppetry ensemble read, which is the line Kolibri settled. Were a named puppet company found inside it, the Teatro al Parco would count as a stage tomorrow. Two more fall on the museum ruling of the same day or on unread backing — the Casa delle Marionette of the Teatro del Drago in Ravenna is a museum, and the Casa Gianduja of the Marionette Grilli in Turin, opened in December 2024 as a museum-theatre with halls and a workshop, was not read for public support. Three is what one pass could prove and Italy is certainly larger. The organisations to take next, one by one and each on the question of whether it holds a hall, are the Teatro del Drago beyond its museum, the Marionette Grilli, the Compagnia Carlo Colla e Figli in Milan, Teatro Verde in Rome, Le Nuvole in Naples, and the Fondazione Sipario Toscana. The upper bound is set at 8 to say so.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Italian trainings identified in teatro di figura all belong to private or association bodies outside the denominator: the two-year academy of the Centro Teatro Internazionale in Florence, the Libera Accademia del Teatro dell'Aria attached to the Perugia festival, the Animateria pathway, the Universita dei Burattini in Cesenatico. The only foothold in public education is the Teatro di figura subject taught within the scenography course of the Academy of Fine Arts in Catania: a subject in a curriculum, not a specialised training, and so it does not satisfy the denominator. No specialised degree was found. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the check not having covered the curricula of every academy of fine arts and national drama school. Italy is the case the schema explicitly flags as understated by an institutional indicator. Re-examined on 2026-07-27 after the ownership ruling. Italy is the country the ruling threatened to change most, since the whole of its recorded provision was set aside as private, and private was the word doing the work. Both establishments on record were therefore re-read at source, on the award this time. The Centro Teatro Internazionale in Florence presents itself as an Accademia di formazione teatrale over two years and names no titolo, no diploma and no accreditation: nothing MUR or AFAM, nothing regional. It is excluded on the absence of a state-recognised award, and its reason moves from private to not_degree_granting. The Libera Accademia del Teatro dell'Aria in Perugia could not be settled: its site shows laboratori and formazione teatrale but the pages that would state what, if anything, is awarded were not reachable, so it moves from private to unconfirmed and now carries the source that was actually read. The two remaining trainings named in this reasoning, Animateria and the Universita dei Burattini in Cesenatico, were never opened in either pass and were set aside under the same withdrawn motive; they are not recorded as establishments and stay unexamined. The value holds at 0, but the upper bound of 1 is now doing more work than before: it carries three unopened files, not one gap in coverage.

Excluded because its site names no state-recognised title: since the ruling of 2026-07-27 being private is no ground, awarding nothing the State recognises is.

Its place in the count is unresolved rather than decided: the ruling of 2026-07-27 made the award the test, and what it awards could not be read.
